title: 5866 Galveston Road

5866 Galveston Road
Belton, TX 76513
$325,000, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 2,150 SF, MLS# 615224

Looking for a beautiful home with an assumable low interest rate? Look no more! This 3BR/2BA home has an assumable interest rate of 2.5%! Stepping into the home’s foyer, the office will be on your right. The entry opens up to the gorgeous kitchen, with granite countertops, a built-in double oven, and a walk in pantry.
The large dining area is off of the kitchen. From the dining room, you will see the enormous family room. Off of the family room is the master ensuite, with a large tub and a separate shower. The two minor bedrooms are on the opposite side of the home, and are separated by a game room. With 2150 square feet, this home will be an asset for any growing family. The office and game room can easily be used for extra bedrooms! 
This home is located a few minutes off of I4/190 and is in a newer development. The HOA offers walking/biking trails, and areas to picnic. Call your favorite agent today!

2 full bath
